description: Workload annotation injection additional cases: an alternate app id, and an option set adding app-port and config annotations alongside the enabled marker.

input.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: web
  labels:
    app: web
spec:
  containers:
  - name: web
  image: web

cases.expected_output:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  annotations:
    dapr.io/app-id: web-app
    dapr.io/enabled: "true"
  labels:
    app: web
  name: web
spec:
  containers:
  - name: web
  image: web

input.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: web
  labels:
    app: web
spec:
  containers:
  - name: web
  image: web

cases.expected_output:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  annotations:
    dapr.io/app-id: web-app
    dapr.io/app-port: "8080"
    dapr.io/config: appcfg
    dapr.io/enabled: "true"
  labels:
    app: web
  name: web
spec:
  containers:
  - name: web
  image: web
